svg.title: T02 report timing and firmware labels
svg.text: T02 / Report timing and firmware labels
These are reporting clocks, not PCM sample timestamps. Marked gaps do not prove audio DMA stopped.
Firmware labels are shown only at received rows, without filling state duration. Embedded log payloads stay excluded.
Teal: host delta. Rust: device delta. Horizontal offset separates overlapping dots.
Teal: host delta. Rust: device delta. Horizontal offset separates overlapping dots.
Teal: host delta. Rust: device delta. Horizontal offset separates overlapping dots.
Host receive elapsed time (seconds). Detailed clock events and gap boundaries are preserved in summary.json.
